verdict.rationale: The pack has no Pipecat or Pipecat Cloud documentation of a training opt-out, a no-training data policy, or any control over whether user data trains AI models. Community notes that Pipecat can run local inference through ollama or whisper describe a self-hosting workaround, not a documented training-exclusion capability, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
